title: 45-second fix: find pages quietly losing clicks

beats.say: Your best page can slide for months, and Search Console won't alert you when its clicks slip.
Open Performance, then Search results. Click the date filter, choose Compare, then last three months to previous period.
Scroll down to the table and open the Pages tab. You'll get a Clicks Difference column.
Sort that column so the biggest drops sit on top. That's your fix list, already in order.
beats.show: Biggest drops on top: *fix these first*

beats.say: Why those first? They lost the most clicks, so they have the most to win back. Click one, open the Queries tab, and see which searches slipped.
beats.show: Most clicks lost, *most to win back*

beats.say: Follow for one Search Console fix a week.

caption:
Search Console won't alert you when a page's clicks slip. Here's how to find those pages in under a minute.

1. Search Console, Performance, Search results.
2. Date filter, Compare tab, "Compare last 3 months to previous period".
3. Scroll to the table and open the Pages tab.
4. Sort the Clicks Difference column so the biggest drops are on top.
5. Work down from the top: those pages lost the most clicks, so they have the most to win back.

Bonus: click a page, then open the Queries tab to see which searches it stopped winning.

What's the first thing you check when a page starts slipping?
topic: Find the pages quietly losing traffic, in Search Console, in under a minute
